title: T1b
format: html
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
x <- 5
old <- knitr::knit_hooks$get("evaluate.inline")
knitr::knit_hooks$set(evaluate.inline = function(code, envir) {
  w <- character()
  v <- withCallingHandlers(old(code, envir), warning = function(c) { w <<- c(w, conditionMessage(c)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") })
  if (length(w)) paste0("[", v, " WARNED:", w, "]") else v
})
```

Multi `r x +
1` end. Single `r x + 1` end. Warn `r as.integer("a")` end. Q `{r} as.integer("b")` end.
